samples: The sport invented in Springfield, Massachusetts is called "football." The number of players per side in this sport is 11. This sport is played on a field with goalposts at each end, and the objective is to score points by carrying or kicking the ball into the opposing team's end zone. The game is divided into four quarters, and the team with the most points at the end of the game wins. The sport has a rich history and has evolved over time, with various rules and regulations being added and modified. It is a popular sport in many countries and has a large following worldwide.
